go.desc: The start of every lap. Passing GO — or landing on it — pays your salary, collects passive income from everything you own, and refreshes your meta-action allowance.
go.note: Pinjol interest is also charged once per lap, at the start of your next turn.

tax.descCash: Landing here charges income tax on the cash in your hand. Property you own is untouched.
tax.descWealth: Landing here charges luxury tax on your total wealth — cash plus the market value of every tile you own.
tax.note: A tax-free pass card waives the charge automatically.
tax.noteOjol: Your Ojol Driver passive halves the rate.

event.desc: Draw a Kejadian Nasional card — a nationwide event. They hand out windfalls, charge everyone at once, or shift rent and tiers across whole regions for a few rounds.

hustle.desc: Draw a Hustle card — a side gig. Most pay cash on the spot; a few cost you, grant a free-pass card, or move your token to another tile and resolve it like a landing.

jailVisit.desc: Just visiting — nothing happens when you land here. This is also the cell where jailed players are held.

jailGo.desc: Straight to jail. You're moved to the Penjara tile at once and can't move again until you're out.
jailGo.note: A jail-free pass card cancels it, and a Pejabat is never jailed.

lawOffice.desc: Land here and pick one legal power — or skip. Only the player standing on the tile may act.
lawOffice.buy: Buy any unowned tile remotely, at its normal price.
lawOffice.forceBuy: Force-buy a rival's property: open a bid at {{percent}}% of its value — the owner may out-bid you to keep it.
lawOffice.jail: Send a rival to jail for {{fee}}.
lawOffice.freepass: Buy a free-pass card — rent, tax, or jail — for {{price}}.
lawOffice.priceUpgrade: Permanently multiply one tile's price ×{{min}}–{{max}}, lifting its rent, passive income, and resale value.
lawOffice.note: A Pengacara pays half of every law-office fee.

vacation.desc: Landing here summons everyone to the mountain: every active player is moved to this tile and each pays the vacation fee to the bank.
vacation.note: Jailed players stay put and pay nothing. Being summoned here never pays GO salary.

land.desc: Bare land, yours for {{price}}. Once you own it, build one of two businesses on the plot and upgrade it through four tiers.
land.descOwned: This plot is taken. Its owner can build one of two businesses on it and upgrade that through four tiers.
land.note: Dapur MBG leans on guaranteed passive income each lap; Warkop-Cafe leans on steep rent when a rival lands on it. One business per plot — the choice is permanent.

sellConfirm.title: Sell property?
sellConfirm.loseDevelopment: {{name}} — every tier you built is torn down
sellConfirm.loseBusiness: {{business}} ({{tier}}) — the whole business is torn down
sellConfirm.losePriceBoost: The ×{{mult}} price boost you bought at the Law Office
sellConfirm.loseRegionSet: The {{region}} set bonus — your other {{region}} tiles drop back from ×{{mult}} rent
sellConfirm.loseTransportRung: A rung on the transport ladder — your {{count}} remaining transports drop from {{before}} to {{after}} rent
sellConfirm.permanent: The tile goes back on the market at its base price. This can't be undone.
